name: KFC
cuisine: Fast Food, Steak, Grill Chicken & BBQ
description: KFC (Kentucky Fried Chicken) is a global fast food chain founded by Colonel Harland Sanders, famous for its original recipe fried chicken seasoned with 11 herbs and spices.

name: McDonald's
description: McDonald's is the world's largest fast food chain, serving billions of customers daily with iconic menu items including the Big Mac, McChicken, and golden french fries.

name: Burger King
description: Burger King is a global American fast food chain best known for the flame-grilled Whopper burger and its 'Have It Your Way' customisation philosophy.

name: Dicos
description: A Chinese fast food chain serving fried chicken sandwiches, burgers, and sides in the style of American quick-service restaurants.

name: Starbucks
description: Starbucks is the world's largest coffeehouse chain, offering handcrafted espresso beverages, Frappuccinos, teas, and seasonal drinks alongside food items and merchandise.

name: Pacific Coffee
description: A Hong Kong-based coffee chain serving espresso drinks, cold brews, and light cafe snacks widely popular across Asia.

name: Luckin Coffee
description: Luckin Coffee is a Chinese fast-growing coffee chain known for its app-based mobile ordering system, convenient pick-up locations, and affordable specialty coffee drinks.

name: Tao Tao Ju
description: A heritage Cantonese restaurant with roots in traditional Guangzhou cuisine, serving dim sum, noodles, and classic Chinese dishes.

name: Guangzhou Restaurant
description: A Cantonese restaurant serving traditional Guangzhou-style dim sum, roast meats, and regional Cantonese dishes.

name: Yoshinoya
description: Yoshinoya is a Japanese fast food chain founded in 1899, specialising in gyudon (beef rice bowls) and known as one of the oldest and most iconic gyudon chains in the world.

name: Lao Guang Ji
description: A traditional Cantonese restaurant serving classic Guangdong dishes including rice porridge, stir-fries, and roasted meats.

name: Way Yu Lau
description: A Cantonese seafood restaurant serving fresh seafood dishes, congee, and traditional Guangdong specialties.

name: Master Kong / Meetrice
description: A Chinese fast food counter serving instant noodle-style dishes and quick rice-based meals inspired by the popular Master Kong brand.

name: Lanzhou Noodles
description: A noodle restaurant specializing in Lanzhou-style hand-pulled beef noodle soup, a Northwest Chinese specialty.

name: Ji Xiang Hun Tun
description: A Chinese noodle and wonton restaurant serving wonton soups and noodle dishes in classic Cantonese style.

name: Peter Steak House
description: A steakhouse restaurant serving grilled steaks, Western-style mains, and set meal options.

name: Lok Tao
description: A Chinese restaurant serving a broad range of Cantonese and Chinese dishes including congee, dumplings, and noodle soups.

name: Xiao Noodles
description: A casual noodle bar serving a variety of Chinese noodle soups and stir-fried noodle dishes.
